info.text:
IRS call demanding gift cards? It's fake. Here's the tell.
Americans reported losing about $15.9 billion to fraud in 2025, up from $8.8 billion in 2022 (FTC).
Imposter scams took more than $3.5 billion in 2025.
The real IRS normally contacts you first by mail, and never demands payment by gift card or wire transfer.
Verify in your IRS.gov account or at a number listed on IRS.gov. Report to phishing@irs.gov, forward texts to 7726.
Sources: IRS, FTC Consumer Sentinel, IRS Dirty Dozen 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
